full_details: The afternoon was the old play, and you were in the house. At the reckoning the share was seventeen shillings, received. There is no new total. Last Saturday's fourteen was not added. The five pound for August was not paid out of this seventeen. Next week is Monday and Wednesday, Two Gentlemen, and you play; Tuesday, rehearsal at nine and Love's Labour's Lost, and you play; Friday, Love's Labour's Lost, and you play; Saturday the twenty-sixth, Errors, and you play. Thursday was not set. James would not rest until he had seen the goldsmith's building. You went on the river for the first time since May, in Davy's boat, with James and Cuthbert. The Rose went by with its flagstaff bare. In Paris Garden the timber is a ring of new oak, wider than the Rose and wider than the Theatre. James said green oak will twist, and that it is bigger than his. Cuthbert said the Lord Mayor wrote to the Lord Treasurer against this house last November, and there it stands, on ground the City cannot touch. Davy said it is Langley's, a goldsmith building a playhouse, and that he will gild the groundlings. That is what you know of the builder. Davy's news was six Spanish galleys off the north coast of Cornwall. Four has been heard. Nobody in the boat believed either figure. You did not correct him. You did not land.
one_sentence: You took seventeen shillings, and from the boat the new timber was green oak and too big.
title: Seventeen shillings, and green oak from the boat
